title: 13 Great Games You Can Buy Right Now!*
body:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UyFtwB6-RNs

Daniel (@dungeondive) answers a practical objection to his recent top tens: what about games you can actually find? This occasional buying-guide episode gathers thirteen adventure games and dungeon crawls that he checked at official retailers or publisher stores in the United States as of November 14, 2026. Availability elsewhere, shipping and additional fees remain outside that check, and he excludes resellers and Game Crafter titles.

The selection mixes recent favourites with accessible alternatives. HeroQuest offers a framework for official and fan-made adventures, Fallen Land Second Edition supplies a sprawling post-apocalyptic sandbox, and Vantage earns praise for making open-world exploration easy to learn and return to. Mini Rogue: The Council provides a smaller-box option, while the anniversary edition of Tales of the Arabian Nights gets special attention for its solo material.

Daniel also revisits app-supported Freelancers, dice-manipulation adventures in Role Player Adventures, and the different pleasures of Cthulhu: Death May Die and Eldritch Horror. Horrified stands out as an approachable introduction to thematic gaming. Skyrim's adventure board game receives praise for its sense of discovery alongside a warning about its rulebook.

The closing pick is The Restless, whose unusual art and outsider sensibility make it especially memorable to Daniel. Rather than another ranked countdown, this is a varied companion list, with reasons to investigate each game and caveats drawn from his own play experiences.
